facts: Deadly Premonition is a survival horror video game.
Deadly Premonition was developed by Access Games.
Deadly Premonition is set in the fictional, rural American town of Greenvale, Washington.
The story of Deadly Premonition follows FBI Special Agent Francis York Morgan.
The story of Deadly Premonition involves investigating the murder of an eighteen-year-old woman.
Deadly Premonition was originally released in 2010 for Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.
The Xbox 360 version of Deadly Premonition was published by Ignition Entertainment in North America.
Marvelous Entertainment released the PlayStation 3 version of Deadly Premonition exclusively in Japan.
A director's cut edition of Deadly Premonition for PlayStation 3 and Microsoft Windows was released worldwide by Rising Star Games in 2013.
Deadly Premonition is a reboot of Access Games' earlier video game Rainy Woods.
Rainy Woods was cancelled soon after its debut at the 2007 convention Tokyo Game Show due to technical issues.
Upon its release, Deadly Premonition received wildly varying critical reviews.
Deadly Premonition eventually held the Guinness World Record for the most critically polarizing survival horror game.
Deadly Premonition has since garnered a cult following.
Deadly Premonition has been cited as an example of games as art.
